test_input: Hold UP for 1 second, then LEFT for 0.5 seconds, then UP for 0.5 seconds, then RIGHT for 0.5 seconds, then gently tap UP to land. Or, hold UP for 2 seconds, then release and let it crash. Press R to restart. Press ESC to quit.
expected_win_output:
THRUST
ROTATE LEFT
THRUST
ROTATE RIGHT
THRUST
WIN
notes:
Controls (exact console prints):
- UP (thrust): prints 'THRUST' on initial press; while held, a flame is displayed behind the lander. (Implemented in game/lander.gd)
- LEFT (rotate ccw): prints 'ROTATE LEFT' on initial press. (Implemented in game/lander.gd)
- RIGHT (rotate cw): prints 'ROTATE RIGHT' on initial press. (Implemented in game/lander.gd)
- R (restart): prints 'RESTART' and resets the lander to the top. (Implemented in game/game_manager.gd)
- ESC (quit): prints 'QUIT' and exits the game. (Implemented in game/game_manager.gd)
Game outcome prints:
- 'WIN' printed on successful landing; HUD shows 'WIN' and physics freeze. (game/game_manager.gd, game/lander.gd, game/landing_pad.gd)
- 'GAME OVER' printed on crashing; HUD shows 'GAME OVER' and physics freeze. (game/game_manager.gd, game/lander.gd, game/landing_pad.gd)
HUD:
- Top-left speed shown as 'Speed: N' updated each frame (game/game_manager.gd reads lander.velocity).
Notes and limitations:
- All visuals are simple Canvas drawing (no external images or audio) as required.
- Landing detection is a simple bottom-y intersection check with the pad and checks vertical speed and tilt angle thresholds; it does not perform complex physics contact resolution.
- The speed printed is the integer magnitude of the lander's velocity vector.
- Restart restores lander position, rotation and zeroes velocity; any post-freeze state is cleared.
- Window title 'Moon Hopper' is set in game/project.godot.
- Files implementing the core behavior: game/lander.gd (physics, input, rendering, flame, bounce), game/landing_pad.gd (pad geometry), game/game_manager.gd (state, HUD, win/lose, restart, quit).
